headline.text: L1 Sollich 3 labeler A still down after *3 hours* on wrinkle issues — labeler B running, product reworked without labels.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran four Sollich lines with mixed results. S3 labeler A went down at 08:00 on wrinkle issues and stayed down through end of window — B-side labeling only, product staged as rework. S1 fought metal detector faults all shift; incline belt skipping cleared but MD parameter change at 10:16 didn't hold. S4 ran clean after a 20-minute garden-area sensor pause at 16:26.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 moulding line struggled with flow wrapper all shift. Line stopped at 06:50 on bar-spacing jams from curved conveyor, cleared by 07:39. Film jams and double-wrapping forced two CILTs (04:56, 09:58). FFS and ML3 ran routine with no issues.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ran five lines with temper and equipment friction. ML1 went down at 05:15 on high temper (0.8), cleared by 06:28 after pump speed changes. Truffle line completed a 3-hour reheat overnight, then fought Cute Cavanna sensor faults and a frozen water-cooling stage at 09:54. Matrix ran out of WIP at 11:36 and paused for changeover. ML4 tape machine jammed twice but cleared inside 30 minutes each time.

notes.text: White chocolate for Tate's cleared for production at 18:40.
WDS software update completed at 00:46; tech confirmed warning message is non-blocking and can be ignored.
Shawn added crystallization pump speed to ML1 temper check in QISoft at 08:48.

resolved.title: S1 temper unit pump faulted on pressure
resolved.summary: Pump on temper unit shut down due to pressure fault, requiring full reheat procedure.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:05 — "The pump turned on and is working. Tempering the chocolate again" (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: S4 garden area mark registration sensor fault
resolved.summary: Mark registration sensor causing 20-minute pause in garden area.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 16:35 — "I believe I've fixed the issues with the mark registration sensor" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: S1 double pieces issue
resolved.summary: Seeing more double pieces than usual; maintenance adjusted gap between Tunnel 1 and separator table, then lowered caramel drop size.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:21 after dropping caramel from 6.0 to 5.9 and angling blower forward — "should see further improvement" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: S3 tape machine jamming at pack area
resolved.summary: Caddie sticker machine tape broke; operator repaired it, then maintenance made further adjustments after second jam.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 06:49 after maintenance worked on it; line resumed production.

resolved.title: S1 incline conveyor skipping on startup
resolved.summary: Belt started skipping when line came up; pause called to pass accumulation at top of MMs.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:21 after maintenance adjusted belt speed to 55; skipping stopped and line resumed.

resolved.title: S3 belt after demolding ripping on north side
resolved.summary: Belt was ripping due to tracking issues; maintenance adjusted tracking and QA approved continued run.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 08:17 — "This has been fixed" (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: S4 tropical syrup vault stuck
resolved.summary: Vault to tropical syrup got stuck, causing 20-minute pause without caramel.

resolved.title: S1 caramel hopper level sensor fluctuating

resolved.resolution: Fixed at 12:08 — level reading improved 95% and remained stable after blocking sunlight (Erandy Garcilazo Ceja).

resolved.title: ML2 bars not coming straight from curved conveyor
resolved.summary: Bars misaligned from curved conveyor causing blow-offs and jams; long belts appeared to have been changed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:39 — "Line is back up" after Justin adjusted bar spacing (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 film jam on flow wrapper

resolved.title: ML2 line down for CIL at 04:56

resolved.resolution: Completed by 05:31; line resumed production.

resolved.title: ML2 double and triple wrapping after CIL

resolved.resolution: Fixed at 10:41 — "Line is back up" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML1 temper high at 0.8, line down
resolved.summary: Temper slope reading 0.8 (out of spec), line stopped at 05:15 to bring temper down.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 06:28 after slowing to 15 MPM and increasing crystallization pump speed — temper back in yellow range.

resolved.title: ML4 tape machine problem at 06:18

resolved.title: ML4 gondola jam at 03:22

resolved.title: Truffle line cold coconut oil clogging
